children: Chainflip has activated BNB Chain on its mainnet, extending native cross-chain swaps to BNB Chain assets after a testnet phase. The integration connects the protocol's swapping infrastructure directly to one of the largest active ecosystems, without wrapped tokens or intermediary custodians.

Mainnet support for BNB Chain means swap flow between that ecosystem and Chainflip's other connected chains settles through the protocol, adding a concrete volume and fee avenue for FLIP. Because fees and staking returns on Chainflip scale with settled volume, the integration ties the token's staking thesis to usage on a high-activity chain. BNB Chain assets can be swapped natively, so users avoid the wrapping steps common in cross-chain transfers.
BNB Chain has reached the Chainflip Testnet.
The countdown to BNB on Mainnet begins.

title: Chainflip: BNB Chain goes live on mainnet for native asset swaps - Sep 2026
